verbatim_quote.original: نه، به نظرم خیلی پیچیده می‌شه. الان نیاز به انجام دادنش نداریم.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: No, I think it becomes too complicated. We do not need to do it right now.

extracted_decision.summary: Rejected chaining Psiphon with WARP (usque MASQUE client) to gain UDP support; chose the simpler TCP-only split instead.
extracted_decision.rationale: Triple-userspace chain (tun2socks to usque to Psiphon) was judged too complex and unproven for the gain.
alternatives: usque --http2 through Psiphon HTTP proxy for US edge with UDP-over-H2
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: UDP stays on the direct path with server geo; no UDP-over-tunnel capability.
